channel.title: Comments on: I, Amoeba

item.title: By: carl
item.dc:creator: carl
item.description:
"where did the NOW go"
It sure goes by fast now doesn't it? That means I'm enjoying life more now (i.e., time crawls when you're not enjoying life), but this so called enjoyment is so different than I thought it would be way back when. I mean my eyes are failing, my body is weakening, my memory is slipping. Yes, AllandNone, I agree, "it is easy stumbling around and admitting I know nothing". ;-)

item.title: By: AllandNone

item.description: “where not to go” Actually I think the Amoeba is ahead of the human race. I am also almost 70 years old, where did the NOW go. Oh, here it is! I am in total agreement with you. I just have fun stumbling around and admitting I know nothing! It beats boredom. lol
